name: Separator
summary: Separates content or controls along an axis.

avoidWhen: A divider that people drag to resize panels; use Resizable

web.html.reason: No framework-free web implementation exists. Use the web.react binding.

behavior: A semantic separator is exposed to assistive technology
A horizontal Separator renders an hr; a vertical one renders a div with the separator role and aria-orientation set to vertical.
A vertical Separator is 1px wide and takes the height of the flex or grid row it sits in.
A vertical Separator in a block parent, or in a row with nothing else in it, has no height.
accessibility: Expose separator role and orientation for non-decorative separators
